title: Normalized FIRMS observation 1.3.0
description: Logical JSON representation of one accepted Parquet record, including Hive acquisition_year/month partition values. Dates/timestamps serialize as ISO 8601, timestamps UTC. Raw fields remain strings, including empty strings. source_product distinguishes NRT from standard/science-processing (_SP) archive streams; this is not a prediction/target or harmonized sensor measurement.

source_record_number.description: CSV data-record ordinal, excluding header; not a physical line number when quoted fields span lines.

source_url.description: User-declared reference, not fetched or verified; null when unknown.

available_at.description: Unknown; acquisition time is never used as an availability proxy.

confidence_percent.description: MODIS original confidence, not a calibrated fire probability or comparable VIIRS score.

brightness_i4_k.description: VIIRS I-4; bright_ti4 or NASA documented brightness web-service alias.

brightness_i5_k.description: VIIRS I-5 from explicit bright_ti5 only; never inferred from bright_t31.

brightness_k.description: Original brightness value: MODIS channel21/22 or VIIRS documented I-4 alias, sensor-specific.

bright_t31_k.description: Original bright_t31 value in K. MODIS channel31; VIIRS channel semantics unconfirmed, no I-5 mapping.

frp_mw.description: Pixel-integrated fire radiative power MW, not burned area.

hotspot_type.description: FIRMS inferred hotspot class from the archive/SP `type` column: 0 presumed vegetation fire, 1 active volcano, 2 other static land source, 3 offshore. Null when the column is absent (NRT) or empty: unknown, not vegetation fire.

source_fields.description: All parsed CSV field strings, original names and values including unsupported extra columns; not original CSV byte quoting.
